name: Tortilla Egg Roll with Prosciutto, Mozzarella & Basil

instructions.primary_message: Wash basil. Pick leaves off the stems; discard the stems and thinly slice the leaves into ribbons.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Crack the eggs into a large bowl and season with crushed red pepper; whisk together.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 eggs
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Pour one-sixth of the egg mixture (or about ⅓ cup) into the skillet and swirl to make an omelet the size of a tortilla. Let cook, undisturbed, for 30 seconds. Before the egg fully sets, place a tortilla on top and press down gently with a spatula.

When the egg is cooked, after about 1 minute, flip the tortilla. Working quickly, sprinkle one-sixth of the cheese and basil over the egg, followed by 2 slices prosciutto; let cook 30-60 seconds more. Transfer to a plate and roll tortilla tightly to close. Cover with aluminum foil until ready to serve.
Add more oil (½ tsp per tortilla) to the skillet and repeat with remaining egg mixture, tortillas, cheese, basil, and prosciutto.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil
5 large flour tortillas
10 slices prosciutto

instructions.primary_message: To serve, slice rolls in half and divide between plates. Enjoy!
